subject: Urgent: VecAPI heatwave after catalog promotion — HarvestAI p95/p99 spike
messages:
From: Alice W. <alice@harvestai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@harvestai.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: VecAPI latency: p99 up ~6x since today's model promotion

Evelyn / Monica —

We pushed against our embedding pipeline this morning around 08:30 PT after the catalog promotion and immediately started seeing significant p95/p99 regressions on the hosted embeddings endpoint (vec-api). Quick numbers from our monitoring (sample window 08:30-09:00):
- p50: ~16ms (unchanged)
- p95: 230ms -> 1.1s
- p99: 420ms -> 2.6s

Error rate briefly spiked to ~1.4% (timeouts) and throughput dropped under load. This is causing search latency to surge for our customers. We rolled back locally to the previous pinned model and our metrics returned to baseline, which suggests the catalog promotion correlates with the regression.

We need an immediate mitigation on the hosted side (route us back to the previous model or pin our tenant) and a short postmortem/ETA for a permanent fix. Harvest AI is pushing this to their ops and execs. Please advise next steps and whether you can force routing at your end while you investigate.

Attachments: p95_p99_snapshot_20261108.csv (sample), short traces attached

—Alice
VP Product, Harvest AI

- Can SRE/ModelOps force routing for Harvest AI to previous model variant (or pin their tenant) while we investigate?
- Rishi: please prioritize a quick triage to confirm whether the promoted artifact has a different quantization/kernel path or a KV-cache incompatibility.
- Ben/Sean: I'll need a one-line customer-facing mitigation note and to know whether we should offer credits preemptively.

I'll coordinate an hour-block exec sync at 10:30 PT if we need leadership. Monica — please keep Alice updated with the mitigation timeline and confirm they are OK with us changing routing.

—Evelyn

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-08T09:49:00-08:00
Subject: Re: VecAPI latency: p99 up ~6x since today's model promotion

Triage notes (quick):
- I pulled the traces Alice attached and a few live samples from our backend. Initial signal: requests hitting the newly promoted model variant are exhibiting cache-miss amplification and markedly longer kernel execution paths. The promoted artifact (v1.4.0-quant) follows a slightly different quantization pipeline and triggers a different fused-kernel set on our runtime.
- On top of that, the model shape change (longer kv cache warm-ups for multi-turn calls) means at high concurrency the scheduling stacks more micro-batches and increases tail latency.

Immediate mitigations I can do right now (need approval):
A) Force per-tenant routing policy to previous variant (v1.3.7) for harvestai: low risk, immediate relief.
B) Flip an autoscaling policy to add 2 extra dedicated workers to absorb load while we investigate (medium risk).
C) Revert the catalog promotion globally (high blast radius — not recommended as first step).

I attached a short trace bundle (trace_sample_11-08.zip) and a diff of routing_policy for the tenant (routing_policy_diff.txt). Recommend A now, B if traffic doesn't normalize within 30 minutes. I'll start a deeper profiling run to compare kernel latencies and report back.

—Rishi
Principal SW Engineer, Inference Runtime
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: VecAPI latency: p99 up ~6x since today's model promotion

Alice — thanks for the quick report and for sharing the traces. We can do option A (force your tenant to previous variant v1.3.7) immediately. Please confirm you give us permission to change routing for your account; this is reversible from our side.

If you approve, Rishi will implement the per-tenant routing override and we will monitor p95/p99 for the next 60 minutes. We'll also prepare the credit proposal Ben suggested and circle back with an ETA for a full engineering RCA.

—Monica

Attached: routing_policy_diff.txt, short metrics snapshot. I'll continue the kernel profiling and share a technical RCA by EOD. If tail latency remains elevated after 30 minutes, we should consider autoscale (option B).

—Rishi

Subject: Executive summary and next steps (Harvest AI vec-api incident)

Quick exec summary for records and leadership:
- Incident: p95/p99 latency spike observed after catalog promotion of v1.4.0-quant (2026-11-08 08:25 PT). Impact: transient errors and customer-visible latency for Harvest AI; other tenants unaffected.
- Immediate mitigation: per-tenant routing override to v1.3.7 applied at 10:14 PT (Rishi). Metric recovery observed within 10 minutes.
- Root-cause hypothesis: quantization/kernel selection differences in v1.4.0-quant combined with kv-cache warm-up behavior leading to tail amplification under concurrency.
- Short-term actions: engineering to deliver RCA by EOD (Rishi), ops to run canary promotion plan and update rollout docs, CS/Sales to propose a commercial credit (Ben/Sean).
- Recommendation for execs: approve a customer credit up to 30% for impacted window and fund a postmortem call with Harvest AI tomorrow (10:00 PT).

Ben/Sean: please confirm the credit amount and whether you want me to send the formal offer. I'll draft the joint postmortem invite after Rishi posts the RCA.

—Evelyn
